chunks.title: PDS 2024 - How we value your car
chunks.text: If your car is a total loss we pay its market value at the time of the loss, less your excess. Market value is what it would reasonably cost to buy a car of the same make, model, age, condition and kilometres.

chunks.title: PDS 2024 - Police report
chunks.text: For a collision involving another vehicle we may decline the claim if you do not give us a police report number when we ask for it.

chunks.title: PDS 2024 - When we ask for more information
chunks.text: If we ask you for more information, we will review it and tell you our decision within 10 business days of receiving it.

chunks.title: PDS 2024 - Repair guarantee
chunks.text: Repairs carried out by our authorised repairers are guaranteed for 3 years.

chunks.title: PDS 2026 - How we value your car
chunks.text: If your car is a total loss we pay its market value at the time of the loss, or the agreed value if one is shown on your certificate, less your excess. Market value is what it would reasonably cost to buy a car of the same make, model, age, condition and kilometres.

chunks.title: PDS 2026 - Police report
chunks.text: For a collision involving another vehicle we may decline the claim if you do not give us a police report number when we ask for it.

chunks.title: PDS 2026 - When we ask for more information
chunks.text: If we ask you for more information, we will review it and tell you our decision within 15 business days of receiving it.

chunks.title: PDS 2026 - Lifetime repair guarantee
chunks.text: Repairs carried out by our authorised repairers are guaranteed for as long as you own the car.

chunks.title: Claims procedure - Assessor dispatch
chunks.text: An assessor must be assigned within 5 business days of lodgement. If none is assigned within 10 business days, the claims officer escalates to the assessment team lead as urgent and the customer is told when to expect contact.

chunks.title: Claims procedure - Documents received after a decline
chunks.text: When documents arrive after a claim has been declined, the claim is reopened for re-assessment by a claims officer with delegated authority. Contact centre staff and automated agents cannot change a claim decision.

chunks.title: Claims procedure - Faults after repair
chunks.text: If a customer reports a fault after a repair, book an inspection with the original repairer within 5 business days under the repair guarantee.

chunks.title: Claims procedure - Valuation disputes
chunks.text: If a customer disputes a valuation, comparable listings they supply are reviewed by a valuation specialist, who may revise the offer.

chunks.title: Code of Practice (illustrative) - Claim decision timeframe
chunks.text: We will decide your claim within 4 weeks of receiving all the information we need, and keep you informed at least every 20 business days.

chunks.title: Code of Practice (illustrative) - Appointing an assessor
chunks.text: If we need an assessor, we will appoint one within 10 business days of your claim.

chunks.title: Code of Practice (illustrative) - Complaints
chunks.text: We will give you a final response to your complaint within 30 calendar days.

chunks.title: AFCA notice
chunks.text: If you are not satisfied with our response, you can contact the Australian Financial Complaints Authority, a free and independent service: www.afca.org.au or 1800 931 678.
